svg.text: Same references and net names on every variant. Grey parts are not fitted on Relay.
Nets, the same colour on every sheet
Relay: U2 fitted, U5 SHT40 on J3, JP1 open. No PM sensor.
D2, D3, D6 and D7 are free on a Relay. The radio takes D8 to D10 and GPIO38 to 42.
Never power the radio without its antenna.
resettable fuse, feeds J1 and J2
ANT: U.FL, pigtail, SMA bulkhead, whip
never power the radio without it
close JP1 only for a bare SEN54
SW1 needs no resistor, the firmware turns on GPIO1's
D3 · GPIO4 is VBAT_SENSE, used only with the Bayu
U2's edge pads over D0 to D4 carry its radio lines, so the
header goes into the XIAO only.
